answer: Concrete sybil resistance via quill signatures: each work submission carries a unique quill signature derived from hardware fingerprint and workload entropy, making duplication infeasible. Mirror nodes independently replay each computation and compare results; divergence flags the identity. A sparrow quorum of three random mirror nodes must reach unanimous consensus before rewards pay. An attacker running N sybils must produce N distinct quill signatures surviving mirror replay and passing sparrow consensus, paying full hardware and compute cost per head with no shortcut.
